name: chozrim
description: Chozrim — digital loyalty cards. Dev/test dependencies only; the site itself is static.

scripts.test:rules: cd firebase && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-chozrim "node --test ../tests/rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:e2e: cd firebase && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-chozrim "node ../tests/e2e.mjs"
scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:e2e
